name: Turkey, White Bean & Kale Soup
subtitle: Instant Pot soup with ground turkey, cannellini, kale and lemon, with crusty bread

macros.portion: About 2½ cups soup, 1½ Tbsp parmesan and a 1½ oz slice of bread.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number.

before: **1.7 lb ground turkey** thawed in the fridge.
notes: The kale goes in after pressure cooking so it stays green and holds some texture, and the lemon goes in off the heat so it stays bright. Scrape the pot bottom completely clean after adding the broth, or the Instant Pot can throw a burn warning.

items: 3 cans cannellini beans (15 oz each), drained and rinsed

steps.title: Prep the vegetables
steps.body: Dice **1 onion**, **2 carrots** and **3 ribs celery** into one bowl. Mince **6 cloves garlic** into a small bowl.

steps.title: Brown the turkey
steps.body: Instant Pot on Sauté (high). **1 Tbsp olive oil**, then **1.7 lb turkey**; break it up and cook **6–7 min** until no pink remains and some bits brown. While it cooks, drain and rinse **3 cans cannellini** and open **1 can diced tomatoes**.

steps.title: Vegetables and spices
steps.body: Add the onion-carrot-celery bowl, the garlic, **2 tsp Italian seasoning**, **¼–½ tsp red pepper flakes**, **1¼ tsp salt** and **½ tsp pepper**. Cook **3 min**, stirring.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.body: Pour in **4 cups bone broth** and scrape the bottom until nothing sticks. Add the tomatoes and beans; stir. Lock the lid, sealing, High Pressure **5 min**. It takes about 15 min to come up to pressure.

steps.title: Prep during pressure
steps.body: Zest and juice **1 lemon** (about **2 Tbsp juice**). Slice **5 pieces of bread** and toast if you like.

steps.title: Release and add the kale
steps.body: Quick release. Switch to Sauté, stir in **10 oz kale**, and simmer **3–4 min** until tender. Turn off. Stir in the lemon juice and zest. Mash about **1 cup of beans** against the side of the pot for a thicker soup, if you want. Taste for salt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Each bowl: **about 2½ cups soup** with **1½ Tbsp parmesan** on top, and a slice of bread.

after: Pack 3 lunches of about 2½ cups each; it thickens in the fridge, so add a splash of water when reheating.
Freezes well for up to 3 months. Keep the parmesan and bread separate.
